title: Alexa Duplicate Routine Execution
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alexa:routine
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count as routine_runs by routine_name trigger_id _time
| where routine_runs>1
| sort - routine_runs
description: Uses Alexa routine triggers telemetry to monitor multiple executions from the same trigger window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for duplicate routine runs that annoy the household, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Alexa routine triggers data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Five-minute bucket table of duplicate routine executions.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges multiple executions from the same trigger window so you can spot duplicate routine runs that annoy the household before it becomes annoying.
